name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Use a 4px solid ring at 5:1 contrast with no glow or animation. This meets WCAG 2.1 AA for focus visibility while keeping the ring large enough for mobile/touch users to see it clearly. The trade-off is slightly lower contrast than the 7:1 option, but the 5:1 ring remains visible even on smaller screens where a thinner ring might disappear.

name: Reader
text: A 4px ring at 5:1 contrast still risks blending into glare or low-contrast backgrounds, especially on outdoor mobile screens. A 6px ring at 7:1 contrast with reduced opacity (20%) would keep the focus visible without crowding small buttons, and user testing on glare-prone devices would settle the argument.

name: Ramp
text:
Use a 6px ring at 7:1 contrast with no animation. This keeps focus visible on glare-prone outdoor screens and small touch targets while meeting WCAG 2.1 AA. The trade-off is a slightly larger ring, but it ensures reliability for mobile users and avoids blending into backgrounds.

name: Reader
text: A 6px ring at 7:1 contrast still risks blending into busy or patterned backgrounds, especially on mobile screens with dynamic content. A 2px outer glow at 4.5:1 contrast (WCAG 2.1 AA for non-text) around the 4px ring would keep focus visible without crowding small buttons, and user testing on glare-prone devices would confirm the best balance.
